rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the wrecked or sunken vessel itself, including its visible remains.

example.english: The divers found a shipwreck on the seabed.
example.traditional: 潛水員喺海底發現咗一艘沉船。
example.jyutping: cim4 seoi2 jyun4 hai2 hoi2 dai2 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 sau2 cam4 syun4

rows.note: Use this when referring explicitly to the shipwrecking event or accident rather than the wrecked vessel.

example.english: That shipwreck left many people missing.
example.traditional: 嗰宗沉船事故造成多人失蹤。
example.jyutping: go2 zung1 cam4 syun4 si6 gu3 zou6 sing4 do1 jan4 sat1 zung1
